text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: —I hated the sound of shattering glass.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
"Whenever that sound echoes...
it always pierces me, sharp and cold,
with the weight of the past—"

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: This is......—

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
(My home...
And yet, something feels different...)
—Why?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: (That's—)

text_block_list.name: Young Ardan
text_block_list.text: Why...?! Why... did only my legs have to end up like this...?!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
(Ah... this must be a dream...
That's me back then, when I was first told
the truth about my legs――)

text_block_list.name: Nanny
text_block_list.text:
――Lady Ardan.
Were you painting a picture?

text_block_list.name: Young Ardan
text_block_list.text:
"Yes. You can see the park from here,
so I thought I'd capture the scenery..."

text_block_list.name: Nanny
text_block_list.text:
"This is...
quite a magnificent stroke of the brush."

text_block_list.name: Young Ardan
text_block_list.text:
Thank you very much.
It is all thanks to Nanny teaching me as a pastime
while I was confined to the hospital room.

text_block_list.name: Young Ardan
text_block_list.text:
…………Those children playing over there,
are they about the same age as me?

text_block_list.name: Young Ardan
text_block_list.text:
She looks like she's having so much fun running.
It's almost as if... she's enveloped in light.

text_block_list.name: Nanny
text_block_list.text: Milady—

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: (—To the me back then, the sight of Umamusume running freely outside was so dazzling... It looked like a scene from another world entirely—)

text_block_list.name: Young Ardan
text_block_list.text: Sister... Are your legs really going to be all right...?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Family Trainer
text_block_list.text:
It is all right, Lady Ardan.
Please have faith in Lady Ramonu and watch over her.

text_block_list.name: Young Ardan
text_block_list.text: Yes...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text: —Hup!

text_block_list.name: Young Ardan
text_block_list.text:
Ah, incredible...!
Big Sister, you really can run...!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Family Trainer
text_block_list.text:
"—Her recovery and growth have been phenomenal.
At this rate, her leg issue should be resolved
before she enrolls in Tracen Academy."

text_block_list.name: Young Ardan
text_block_list.text: Sister—

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: (――In truth, after this, Dear Sister completely overcame her innate weakness and enrolled in Tracen Academy.)

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
(And later, she achieved the first-ever
Triple Tiara—)

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: (She will etch her name into history as the jewel of the Mejiro family, Mejiro Ramonu.)

text_block_list.name: Young Ardan
text_block_list.text: It's blinding—

text_block_list.name: Young Ardan
text_block_list.text: I want to be... just like dear sister...!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
(Back then, I was drawn to the sprouting of that aurora,
and then... I clung to it.)

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
—Nanny.
For helping me convince Mother and the others...
Truly, thank you so very much.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
"Thanks to you, I'll be able to attend
Traceno Academy, just like my dear sister."

text_block_list.name: Nanny
text_block_list.text:
...I merely followed Milady's lead.
What changed everyone's hearts was, first and foremost, Milady's own strong conviction.

text_block_list.name: Nanny
text_block_list.text:
"However, Milady, the path you have chosen is the most grueling and arduous of all.
Please do not forget that..."

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
Yes, I am well aware.
...Yet neither fear nor regret exists within me, not even a shred.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
I am the only one who can make myself shine.
For I have decided that this life of mine shall burn brilliantly upon the turf—

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: (...Yes. These feelings haven't changed, even now. And—)

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: (Surely, none of this will ever change in the future either.)

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: —Kh!

text_block_list.name: Instructor
text_block_list.text:
Mejiro Ardan-san!
...Are you alright?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
...There is no problem.
I just felt a slight discomfort in my leg.
There is no pain. I can still continue.

text_block_list.name: Instructor
text_block_list.text:
...Overexertion is strictly forbidden.
Even if you feel fine now, it can affect you later.
Please get checked out properly in the infirmary.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: ...Understood.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: —Hospitalized again...?

text_block_list.name: Attending Physician
text_block_list.text:
Yes. While there are no severe fractures or sprains,
the young lady's legs currently have fatigue accumulated in both bone and muscle,
leaving them in an extremely delicate condition.

text_block_list.name: Attending Physician
text_block_list.text:
This is also related to the effects of her blooming phase...
The rapid growth is placing an excessive burden on the young lady's legs.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: ...In other words, you believe I should be hospitalized and give my legs a rest.

text_block_list.name: Attending Physician
text_block_list.text:
You are quite right.
Milady, rushing into things here would be a grave mistake.

text_block_list.name: Attending Physician
text_block_list.text:
Your legs are gradually, but steadily,
growing stronger.
In time... you will surely grow accustomed to that progress.

text_block_list.name: Nanny
text_block_list.text:
—Please, take care of yourself.
This place is not where you should be putting your life on the line.

text_block_list.name: Nanny
text_block_list.text:
"...Please recall the words you spoke on that day.
For the sake of the 'now' that has arrived, please—"

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: Baaya...—

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: (...Even after this, I would repeatedly be admitted and discharged from the hospital while remaining enrolled at the Academy...)

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
(Days spent facing my own worthlessness, unable to even train properly.
Time idly slipping away――)

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
(Just as one yearns for spring yet shivers in endless winter...
it threatens to freeze these legs, this heart.)

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
(And yet, that blizzard...
finally comes to an end at the very, very last moment.)

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
I want to leave behind a single trace
of my own life's journey in the "now."

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
"...Would you be willing to lend your cooperation,
Trainer?"

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
(That one-and-only debut race I finally seized.
The person I met at the end of it, who accepted my resolve
and swore to walk this path together with me.)

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
(At that moment, I knew for certain
that my history had begun—)

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: ...It was a long dream, wasn't it?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: (And yet, beyond the dream, it still continues—)

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The challenge for the Twinkle Series alongside
Mejiro Ardan is finally beginning in earnest—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The sheer weight of her resolve for racing is staggering.
Bracing myself so I can support those feelings,
I head to the track to prepare for training, when—

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: —Good morning, Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
...Perhaps it is because I had a bit of a dream.
My heart is racing in anticipation
of the Twinkle Series.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: If it's alright with you, Trainer, shall we go for an early morning training session?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, thank you very much.
Well then, let's get right to it, please.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: Haa... haa... haa... haa――

text_block_list.name: Junior Umamusume A
text_block_list.text:
Whoa, it's Mejiro Ardan-senpai!
She's super pumped up from the early morning...

text_block_list.name: Junior Umamusume B
text_block_list.text:
She finally got a trainer recently, right?
Still... she pushes herself so hard, I'm honestly worried she might end up back in the hospital.

text_block_list.name: Junior Umamusume A
text_block_list.text: "Still, with an older sister as amazing as hers, she's kind of got no choice but to work hard, don't you think? To make up for lost time, you know?"

text_block_list.name: Junior Umamusume B
text_block_list.text: ...It must be tough, huh.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Looking at the spectators watching Mejiro Ardan train,
I can sense something akin to pity in their eyes.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
They certainly harbor no ill intent.
And Mejiro Ardan must have received such unwitting
gazes countless times before. However—

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
—Phew.
The final set is now complete.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Paying no mind to those watching eyes,
Mejiro Ardan stays focused entirely on her training.
Determined not to waste a single moment.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"...Then I must also fulfill my duty
as a Trainer so that not a single moment
of this is wasted...!"
choice_data_list: While we're on break, let's decide on your future goals.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
A goal... is it?
If that is the case, I have only one thing to say—

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
To face the debut race staking everything.
For "now," that is all that matters.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
...I understand what you wish to say.
That my previous statement was a given, and that
a true goal should look much further into the future.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
However... as I have said before,
I am someone who could shatter at any moment.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
Therefore, I will stake everything on this single battle ahead.
By doing so, I want to leave a single trace of my "present" self
upon this world at all times.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: Please... could you try to understand?
choice_data_list: —Then we've got to make your debut the absolute best.
—Then we've got to make your debut the absolute best.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I am Mejiro Ardan's Trainer.
How could I ever fulfill my duty without respecting her wishes...!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
...Thank you very much,
Trainer.
It is deeply reassuring to hear you say that.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: Once again... please continue to look after me from here on out.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: —And so, our days of taking on challenges alongside Mejiro Ardan began!
